Was really struggling in the first trimester to do anything other than lie down 😪 now in my second trimester I’m feeling good enough to exercise again and this app was perfect with all the modifications 🙌 Used the regular Downdog app before pregnancy & loved that one too 🥳

Wow what I was looking for and didn’t even know it.. I’m in my second trimester. I have felt some lower back pain, and just assumed I’d have to deal with the pain for the entire pregnancy. A few days ago the pain was more intense… like a pinched nerve called sciatica. It was painful to walk, and I felt hobbled.

I remembered this app and pre-natal yoga. Pelvic floor exercises are recommended to relieve and prevent sciatica and pelvic organ prolapse. I was delighted with how good the session exercises felt. I have neglected to do any yoga or proper stretching in months nausea and a worry that too much time had passed to get back into yoga.

I selected beginner, 2nd trimester, detailed explanations, and boost on pelvic floor. The exercises were at a great pace, I felt better afterwards, and I definitely feel like I could build up to a longer session and/or more than one session a day. Very reasonable thank you to those who created this content and making it available. A wonderful game changer! 

Highly recommend giving it a try. I hope it helps you as much as it has helped me.

reviews.text: Down Dog apps. Each of these apps is so amazing. I’ve been using them for over three years now and I’ll never cancel my subscription. Each practice is completely customizable and perfectly crafted to my needs for that day, down to the music choice.. seriously such a beautiful idea and platform.

Amazing tailored routines. This app is fantastic! You choose your level (anywhere from never took a yoga class to advanced), the type of music you prefer, what trimester you’re in, what body part to focus on, whether you want full yoga or just restorative stretching and how long you want your routine. You even get to choose from several voice options so you don’t end up with someone you don’t find relaxing or enjoyable. It’s a smooth and customizable routine. I never leave reviews but felt this one deserved to be acknowledged for its benefits. I’m still on my free trial but plan to pay for a membership. For $60 per year, their four apps (3 if you’re not pregnant) seems a steal. I also hear they have discounts periodically so watch out for those. I will be!

Not as good as regular Down Dog app, but some nice features. I love the regular down dog app and was thrilled to see them rolls out a prenatal version. It has a lot of the same benefits of the regular app, although there are some things that could use improvement in my opinion. There seems to be a lot less variety of moves in this app vs the regular app. Every session has started with the same couple of poses in sequence (child’s pose followed by crescent lunge sequence). There are only 3 levels of intensity, which I’m guessing is a safety thing as they want to be careful about what they advise pregnant women to do, but that means the app taps out at “intermediate” level. Also there are fewer options as far as yoga styles rather than being able to choose Hatha, Gentle, Vinyasa etc there are just two options (full practice or restorative). I do hope they’ll add a bit more to this app so that it will provides enough variety for me to want to use throughout pregnancy. I think they’re off to a good start!

Crying happy tears!. I was an avid, daily user of the original Down Dog app for a year and a half after having my third baby. When I got pregnant with number four, I was way too sick to do anything for a few months. Once I hit my second trimester I was anxious to get back to yoga, but I found that with all my pregnancy-related ailments I was making so many adjustments and was feeling discouraged that I could do only about 30% of the practice offered. Yoga suddenly took so much mental effort and left me frustrated rather than fulfilled. I’m now in my third trimester (34 weeks) and I seriously nearly cried with joy when I got the email that this app had been released. I hate that I can’t do advanced yoga right now, and that I feel like a 70-yr-old extremely-out-of-shape woman, but this app has made my life so much better! It’s hard to not be where I was, but it is so much better than not being able to do anything. I deal with severe SPD, SI joint pain, extreme heartburn, and pelvic floor issues, so the fact that I can customize my practice to accommodate those things (and many more) is so so so helpful. 

My only complaint is that I can’t select more than one area to focus on, but after doing a few practices in each category I’m sure I’ll be able to do my own adapting as necessary as I learn what poses trigger certain pains, etc. and I’ll be able to avoid certain moves with confidence. I’m sad I’m so far along in my pregnancy, because I wish I’d had this resource for the entirety of it!

Supportive, But Not Fully Inclusive. Firstly, I really appreciate several aspects of the app:
 • I love the variety of yoga styles available (restorative, hatha, gentle, labour prep). It allows me to choose what feels right depending on my energy levels and stage of pregnancy.
 • The “2x Boost” function is excellent. Being able to focus on specific areas like pelvic floor, inner thighs, or lower back is incredibly helpful during pregnancy when certain areas need more targeted support.
 • The customisation options (music and voice selection) are also a big plus. It makes the sessions feel personal and adaptable to different moods and preferences.

A few suggestions that I think would improve the experience:
 • There aren’t many sessions featuring visibly pregnant models, particularly in the third trimester. At that stage, it’s especially helpful to see someone who is heavily pregnant demonstrating how poses are adapted and safely carried out. When models appear very lean or not visibly pregnant, it can make it harder to relate and may create uncertainty about whether poses are being performed in a way that feels realistic for a changing body. Including more third-trimester representation would greatly improve confidence and perceived safety.
 • It would be very helpful to include a structured postnatal programme for the first few weeks after birth. A guided transition from prenatal yoga into the main app would make recovery feel supported and intentional.
 • It would also be great to have session options that incorporate equipment such as yoga blocks, bolsters, or exercise balls, as many pregnant users rely on props for comfort and stability.

Well toned abs for women in third trimester!?. I don’t understand why a visibly non-pregnant, very toned woman is demonstrating exercises for the third trimester. Many of the movements don’t look appropriate for late pregnancy, and that makes me feel unsure about their safety. Because of this, I don’t feel confident using the app.

reviews.text:
Love this app. I discovered Down Dog in the spring when my yoga studio closed and it is amazing! I love how seamless the app transitions between poses and how you can customize the practice! 
I now have the prenatal yoga app and it’s also amazing as I am clueless to what variations to use with my first pregnancy!
Excellent Prenatal Yoga App. Very customisable, varied practices, and feels totally safe for you and baby. I recommend it to all my pregnant friends, it is excellent value.

Complet et doux. Super application. Toujours plaisant de faire les séances au moment qui nous convient. Musique variée qui va bien avec plusieurs « mood ». Images et positions claires. Timbre de voix relaxant et vraiment sympathique.
Je n’ai que de bons mots.

Amazing app!. I’ve been using the regular Down Dog for almost 2 years and have always loved it. When I first became pregnant I thought I would have to switch to a different company app - but turns out Down Dog has a Prenatal yoga app and it’s just as amazing! I’ve been using it for 5 months now and it really follows the growth of your body and always keeps your belly in mind with the poses. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.text: Perfect prenatal yoga. Great instruction, lots of customizable options.

Best prenatal yoga app!. I love that this app allows you to choose your own settings, including trimester, level, and even what parts that you want to strengthen in your body during pregnancy. Best of all, no single work out is the same! This means I’m consistently working different muscle groups with each workout and I’m never bored by the routines. Thanks so much!

Love!. I have been using this app for a couple weeks now and I am so happy with it! There are options to target certain areas, like your low back for example - which is great when you are experiencing discomfort during pregnancy. I will 100% continue with this for my whole pregnancy and switch to the other version after for years to come. Thank you down dog!

Third trimester poses. I love the app, and have been using the regular down dog app for some time now. I’m in my third trimester of pregnancy, and have started trying out this app. I was a little disappointed to find that forward folds make their way into the sequence in many occasions. This pose does not seem conducive to this stage of pregnancy. I would have thought that keeping the setting at “third trimester“ would offer more relevant poses. Hope there may be some changes to come!
Thank you!

reviews.text: I’m a 7 year old boy and I thought this was great!!!. I did this with my mum and she also thought it was great!

Loved it - minor improvement suggested. I really enjoyed the Prenatal yoga app during my pregnancy. It had a positive effect on my health and mobility - was still able to clip my own toenails at 9 months pregnant!

But now baby is here… I’m not quite ready to go back to traditional yoga.

It would be great if the prenatal app could be expanded to include some sessions for easing back into fitness and postpartum recovery.

I realise I could probably do Trimester 1 lessons or slow on the regular app, but with a newborn, I don’t want to have to think and play around. It’d be very handy to have it there and ready to go.

Anyway, just a suggestion!
Fantastic app. Best yoga app I have found. I have used it pre- and post-partum and well into the months after giving birth. Very customisable.

Love this app!!. I absolutely love this range of apps. I can’t go to yoga classes and so this app is perfect for me. 

Just did a prenatal session in the garden, in the sunshine with toddler..better than any class I could attend.
Great for pregnancy. Love how customizable the workouts are.. can even fit them in with a toddler around 😊
Frustrating. Videos take so long to load that it’s not worth it
A great way to workout while pregnant. I love that they give you so many options and boosters. I used this app for my last two pregnancies and then downdogs other workout app afterwards.

Simply amazing and well worth it. I literally NEVER write app reviews (this is my 2nd one ever) but I feel compelled to tell other pregnant women that this app is AMAZING. Especially if you’re Aussie, cos it’s nice to have an Aus accent when most online yoga classes are American. I love the level of customisation to be able to choose length, trimester, intensity and focus points. And the background chill music is ace. I work in tech and I can not fault this app.

Crashing and connection problems. I loved the content and the presentation. Bought a yearly subscription. 
Next day onwards, app is crashing and says connection problems ☹️

Love this app!. It’s great having the option to choose the duration of the yoga class and the pace/level. I feel really safe doing these yoga classes while pregnant and I always feel better afterwards!
Big fan. I loved Down Dog and now I love prenatal Down Dog :) it’s my little bit of me time, I really enjoy the whole experience.

Great compliment to pregnancy. I’ve been using the app since I found out I was pregnant, it’s been an amazing way to start the day. It keeps me moving and stretching. 
Thank you for making yoga so accessible for people who live in remote areas! 
As an idea, is there any way we could change the background of the yoga studio?

Just what I was looking for. I have enjoyed using the Downdog app for years but now I’m pregnant and with some SI joint irritability I needed something specific. There is no prenatal yoga where I live so this app is just the best

Love it!. Love the practice! Gives me an opportunity to show up and fo yoga even when I don’t have energy to go to my regular classes.
Love this!. I have always been a fan of the regular Down Dog but in my third trimester have realized there is a prenatal version. I highly recommend it. Wonderful!

Best yoga experience ever. I can not express enough how good this app is and what amazing value it is. 
There is so much variety in the music and the poses. It is also so customisable. Not only can you customise the length and difficulty or practice, but the type of practice you want, the voice, how detailed instructions are, if you want to focus on a specific part of the body or in pregnancy if you have specific issues you need to work around. 
I honestly prefer this over going to a yoga studio because I am always able to make my practice exactly what I want and need that day, I don’t need to leave my house, can do it whatever time I want and it’s actually affordable. 
They also regularly update the app as well. 
Love love love love love it!
Perfect for pregnancy. Feels amazing on my body and has stopped me getting leg cramps throughout the night. Highly recommend.
